summary: Tamil Nadu experienced widespread monsoon preparations as the IMD issued a red alert for heavy rain across Madurai, Theni, and Dindigul districts. The state government announced major welfare projects, including a 750-crore rupee allocation for farm power connections and new housing schemes. Renowned celebrity chef Damu passed away in Chennai at the age of 72.

stories.headline: IMD Issues Red Alert For Madurai, Theni and Dindigul
stories.summary: The India Meteorological Department has issued a red alert for heavy rainfall in Madurai, Theni, and Dindigul.

stories.headline: Renowned Chef Damu Passes Away at 72 in Chennai
stories.summary: Padma Shri awardee and Guinness World Record holder Chef K. Damodaran, popularly known as Chef Damu, passed away in Chennai. Leaders and fans paid tributes to the veteran culinary icon.

stories.headline: TN Sanctions ₹750 Crore For 50,000 New Farm Power Connections
stories.summary: The Tamil Nadu government has issued an order allocating 750 crore rupees to provide 50,000 new free electricity connections to farmers. The state will bear a major subsidy for the project.

stories.headline: TN Government Sanctions ₹2,882 Crore to Build 12,648 Houses
stories.summary: The Tamil Nadu state government has announced a housing welfare project worth 2,882 crore rupees. Under this initiative, 12,648 new housing units will be constructed for eligible beneficiaries.

stories.headline: Retired Army Officer Arrested in Vellore Over Intelligence Leak
stories.summary: Central agencies and police arrested a retired Army officer in Vellore for allegedly sharing confidential military secrets via WhatsApp. Investigation revealed contact with a foreign agent.

stories.headline: MTC Wins National Award for Urban Transport Financing
stories.summary: Chennai's Metropolitan Transport Corporation received a national recognition award for excellence in urban transport financing. The award highlights public transit operational reforms.

stories.headline: Madras University to Upgrade Web Portal After Cyberattacks
stories.summary: The University of Madras has decided to upgrade its online portal following four cyberattacks within six months. The institution aims to strengthen cyber security and data safety.

stories.headline: TN Para Athletes Praised For Winning 15 Medals at Asian Games
stories.summary: Tamil Nadu athletes were commended for securing 15 medals in parasports events at the Asian Games. State officials lauded the athletes for bringing international honor to the region.

stories.headline: Laxmi Priya Given Additional Charge of Public Grievances
stories.summary: Senior IAS officer Laxmi Priya has been given additional charge as Special Officer for the Mudhalvarin Mugavari grievance redressal initiative to speed up public petition processing.

stories.headline: Onion Prices Rise to ₹60 per Kg at Chennai's Koyambedu Market
stories.summary: Prices of onions witnessed a sharp increase at Chennai's Koyambedu wholesale market, reaching 60 rupees per kilogram. Supplies from neighboring states were hit due to recent heavy rainfall.
